FIND YOUR HUMANPOWER

Find out more about Manpower

Switch On to Local Jobs

huManpower connects you to seasonal, temporary or long-term opportunities that align with your skills, schedule and goals. Explore roles that fit what you’re looking for and switch on new possibilities.

EXPLORE OPPORTUNITIES

Switch On the Talent You Need

huManpower brings sector expertise and talent together, helping you respond faster to change and hire with confidence. When demand rises fast or holds steady, the right talent is ready. So, let’s switch on the talent your business needs.

TALK TO AN EXPERT

Why Manpower

Find Work Fast

Manpower receives new job openings every single day, from companies in the transportation, logistics, engineering and financial service sectors—and more! Find work fast by scrolling our job openings and connecting with a recruiter. 

People First

Advance your career with online training courses, e-learning programs and personalized career guidance. When you’re an active Manpower associate, you’ll qualify for it all!  

Diversity & Inclusion

Work with us to help improve accessibility and opportunity within your local area. We develop and support programs that upskill underrepresented and underserved populations for meaningful and sustainable work.

Your Next Job Is Just a Tap Away 

Whether you're searching for your next opportunity or managing your current assignment, the My Manpower app puts everything at your fingertips. You’ll find smarter job matching, streamlined applications and personalized dashboards— built for how you live and work today. 

DOWNLOAD NOW

Create a profile and we'll guide you to your next job.

Besides great job opportunities, your Manpower account also gives you access to upskilling courses and skills assessments. So, whether you’re looking for a new job or just determining what type of work best suits your talents, your Manpower account will help you on your way.

START NOW

THOUGHT LEADERSHIP

The Q4 ManpowerGroup Employment Outlook Survey results are in!

ManpowerGroup’s latest report reveals that 48% of hiring managers plan to add staff in Q4 2026. Dive into our comprehensive report for detailed insights into job hotspots, industry profiles and workforce trends.

Learn More

Our Specializations

Manpower Engineering

Engineers don't just build phones and rocket ships anymore. From retail to healthcare, there is a wide range of opportunities within the field. For employers, this means having a clear understanding of the skills candidates need to possess to fill your open positions.

READ MORE

Manpower Finance

Source the team you want. Build the team you need. Manpower Finance will provide you with the tools to cultivate a sustainable workforce and pair you with in-demand finance and accounting talent.

READ MORE

Manpower Skilled Technical

Modern manufacturing requires an evolutionary workforce, one whose skills grow over time. Increased demand means increased speed in an ever evolving world of technology. And all that tech needs someone to run, monitor and maintain its functionality.

READ MORE

Manpower and Manpower Engineering Receive Leader and Star Performer Designations 

We are excited to announce that once again, we have been recognized by Everest Group as Leaders in the U.S. Contingent Staffing PEAK Matrix Assessment 2025. Read why Manpower and Manpower Engineering rose to the top in this annual review of the staffing industry.

What do we offer?

High-impact solutions to enhance your competitiveness.

GET STARTED

Talent. Agility. Results.

 Organizations turn to Manpower for high-quality talent and the agility they need to address their specific world of work challenges, with speed. Our recruiters have a deep knowledge of the skills each sector demands. Combined with our talent retention and upskilling programs, you can achieve your business goals when you hire with Manpower.

Our Specializations

Manpower Engineering

Expertise in engineering backed by the power of the Manpower brand — It's how Manpower Engineering delivers the skilled engineering talent and comprehensive workforce solutions you need to optimize your operation.

READ MORE

Manpower Finance

A sustainable workforce is achievable. Manpower Finance employs a team of dedicated search consultants focused on attracting expert finance and accounting talent quickly and at scale.

READ MORE

Manpower Skilled Technical

For industry leaders embracing the next generation of industrial automation, Manpower® Skilled Technical is your first-choice partner for specialized Skilled Technical staffing and workforce solutions to power the modern world of manufacturing.

READ MORE

EXPLORE

Our Manufacturing Solutions

The Right Fit at the Right Time

Manpower's expert manufacturing solutions leverage the full potential of your organization's workforce by designing solutions specifically for your organization's workforce requirements.
FIND OUT MORE

Our Staffing Styles and Solutions

Project Staffing

Staff your short and long-term projects with skilled people who are available just when you need them.

READ MORE

Flexibility Staffing

Manpower offers flexible staffing solutions for your business that allow you to respond to ever-changing demands with confidence.

READ MORE

Onsite Management

Our Onsite Management solutions provide you with a dedicated team that hires the right people, builds better talent, and manages the workforce. Optimizing your workforce – it's what we do best.

READ MORE

Direct Hire

Complete your team with straightforward direct hire solutions. We take great pride in having built a strong community network of great workers.

READ MORE

WORKFORCE INSIGHTS

SEE ALL

What Is Adaptive Manufacturing and Why Does It Matter Today?

Adaptive manufacturing is an approach that enables manufacturers to quickly adjust production, workforce strategies and operations. This is growing in importance due to changing customer demand, supply chain disruptions, labor shortages and other market conditions.

READ MORE

What Are 6 Key Trends in Advanced Manufacturing?

Advanced manufacturing is evolving beyond automation alone. Today's leading manufacturers are combining AI, smart technologies, workforce transformation, data-driven operations and more resilient supply chains to improve productivity and competitiveness.

READ MORE

Why Is the Aerospace and Defense Industry Struggling to Find Talent?

Demand for aerospace and defense talent is accelerating, but the supply of qualified workers is not keeping pace. Engineering, advanced manufacturing, AI, cybersecurity, and skilled technical roles remain difficult to fill as employers compete for scarce talent.

READ MORE

Let's Connect

Tell us what your business needs are. We will create value together with you.

Manpower: Pioneering Job Matches

Manpower, a global leader in employment for over 70 years, combines advanced HR tech with a personal touch. Spanning continents, we connect job seekers with employers, ensuring optimal matches. Understanding industries and individual goals, we fill roles, foster growth, and craft success stories.

Elevate Careers, Amplify Businesses

At Manpower, we're your bridge to growth and opportunity. Driven by our steadfast beliefs, we connect job seekers to dream roles and help employers discover unparalleled talent. Inspired by ManpowerGroup's vision, we innovate, ensuring everyone thrives in today's dynamic work world.

Years of workforce expertise

Small to mid-sized organizations that we work with annually

Manpower Associates on assignment monthly on average

Looking for a Job?

Whether you're looking for a temporary role or a permanent position, Manpower offers a wide range of listings so you can find the job that perfectly meets your preferences. At the same time, our skills training program helps you advance your qualifications and build your confidence. Manpower is here to help you move from the application process to the interview and, ultimately, to a fulfilling job.

LEARN MORE

Optimize Your Workforce

Our staffing solutions ensure optimal job matches while fostering employee productivity, growth, and alignment with your company objectives. We use our expertise in the 10+ industries we serve to create solutions tailored to your organization's needs, connecting you with your ideal pool of skilled candidates.

LEARN MORE

Searching for the Right Talent?

In the diverse talent landscape, pinpointing the ideal candidate can be a challenge. With Manpower, it becomes a seamless endeavor. Drawing from our rich legacy, we comprehend the specific nuances of your hiring needs. Whether a local business or a nationwide enterprise, rely on Manpower to optimize your recruitment success.

REQUEST TALENT

WORKFORCE INSIGHTS

Attracting, Retaining, and Creating Talent with MyPath

Manpower is revolutionizing staffing solutions with MyPath, a comprehensive program that empowers associates to develop essential skills. Through tailored assessments, education initiatives, and full tuition coverage, Manpower ensures candidates are not only job-ready but also equipped to meet the demands of today and tomorrow.

The power that moves people and organizations: huManpower

We are confident that every individual possesses the potential to make a meaningful impact on the world when placed in the appropriate position. The key is identifying that role. You might have already found the one that suits you perfectly. Or maybe you might require the assistance of our Talent Agents and Recruiters to explore what lies ahead. Whether you're seeking temporary or permanent positions, we will support you every step of the way.

LEARN MORE

Manpower is part of the ManpowerGroup family of brands

ManpowerGroup is the world leader in innovative workforce solutions, connecting human potential to the power of business. ManpowerGroup serves both large and small organizations across all industry sectors through our brands and offerings: Manpower, Experis, and Talent Solutions.

FIND YOUR HUMANPOWER

Find out more about Manpower

Switch On to Local Jobs

huManpower connects you to seasonal, temporary or long-term opportunities that align with your skills, schedule and goals. Explore roles that fit what you’re looking for and switch on new possibilities.

EXPLORE OPPORTUNITIES

Switch On the Talent You Need

huManpower brings sector expertise and talent together, helping you respond faster to change and hire with confidence. When demand rises fast or holds steady, the right talent is ready. So, let’s switch on the talent your business needs.

TALK TO AN EXPERT

Why Manpower

Find Work Fast

Manpower receives new job openings every single day, from companies in the transportation, logistics, engineering and financial service sectors—and more! Find work fast by scrolling our job openings and connecting with a recruiter. 

People First

Advance your career with online training courses, e-learning programs and personalized career guidance. When you’re an active Manpower associate, you’ll qualify for it all!  

Diversity & Inclusion

Work with us to help improve accessibility and opportunity within your local area. We develop and support programs that upskill underrepresented and underserved populations for meaningful and sustainable work.

Your Next Job Is Just a Tap Away 

Whether you're searching for your next opportunity or managing your current assignment, the My Manpower app puts everything at your fingertips. You’ll find smarter job matching, streamlined applications and personalized dashboards— built for how you live and work today. 

DOWNLOAD NOW

Create a profile and we'll guide you to your next job.

Besides great job opportunities, your Manpower account also gives you access to upskilling courses and skills assessments. So, whether you’re looking for a new job or just determining what type of work best suits your talents, your Manpower account will help you on your way.

START NOW

THOUGHT LEADERSHIP

The Q4 ManpowerGroup Employment Outlook Survey results are in!

ManpowerGroup’s latest report reveals that 48% of hiring managers plan to add staff in Q4 2026. Dive into our comprehensive report for detailed insights into job hotspots, industry profiles and workforce trends.

Learn More

Our Specializations

Manpower Engineering

Engineers don't just build phones and rocket ships anymore. From retail to healthcare, there is a wide range of opportunities within the field. For employers, this means having a clear understanding of the skills candidates need to possess to fill your open positions.

READ MORE

Manpower Finance

Source the team you want. Build the team you need. Manpower Finance will provide you with the tools to cultivate a sustainable workforce and pair you with in-demand finance and accounting talent.

READ MORE

Manpower Skilled Technical

Modern manufacturing requires an evolutionary workforce, one whose skills grow over time. Increased demand means increased speed in an ever evolving world of technology. And all that tech needs someone to run, monitor and maintain its functionality.

READ MORE

Manpower and Manpower Engineering Receive Leader and Star Performer Designations 

We are excited to announce that once again, we have been recognized by Everest Group as Leaders in the U.S. Contingent Staffing PEAK Matrix Assessment 2025. Read why Manpower and Manpower Engineering rose to the top in this annual review of the staffing industry.
